$comment: Prospective wider regions: groupings of three or more nations that share a calendar, from the Notitiae survey (LiturgicalCalendarAPI docs/decrees/notitiae-register.json; see Frontend #66, #591) plus the five continents (#1018). `id` must match ^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$, permanent once the region is created. `labels` maps a label key (`en`, or a language/language_Script derived from `locales`) matching ^[a-z]{2,3}(_[A-Z][a-z]{3})?$ to a non-empty string; a continent with no curated label yet is `{}` and resolves via `m49`. `m49` is the UN M.49 area code (`^\d{3}$`) for a continent, else null. `roster` = nations eligible to join; `locales` = suggested locales pre-selected on create; `sources` = register entry ids. Ids and labels may change freely until the region is created.

wider_regions.note: Prospective continent: no continent-wide patron or celebration appears in the Notitiae survey. Eritrea (ER) is a UN M.49 002 member but is pruned: it has no entry in WorldDiocesesByNation.json.
The diocese of Bolzano-Bressanone (IT) follows this regional calendar, but a roster can only list whole nations.
